title: 第九章 霸王断江铁血傲骨葬沉沙第十章 双锤长眠四神尽陨国基崩
lines: 断龙原前军战场，煞气滔天，万古悲壮，哀风卷着血沙呼啸过境。
九尺巍峨身躯挺立血土，重瞳凛凛、气贯山河。
西楚霸王项羽手持霸王长枪，枪尖寒芒刺破残云，一身铁血煞气震得周遭星纹剧烈震颤、明暗不定。
四大战神之中，他最擅绝境逆战、愈战愈勇，身负万人敌的无上巨力与不屈傲骨，绝境之下战力可层层暴涨，悍不畏死、越战越烈，唯一短板是无人辅助、无续航兜底，惧怕持续消耗与多维度叠加压制。
十二星曜对其极致绝境战力极为忌惮，不敢小觑，精准抽调三大核心主力合围，专攻其消耗短板，杜绝一切翻盘可能。
狮子?阿煌，星阵近战强攻霸主，狮威霸烈、肉身强横，擅长正面碾压、声波震心，专破绝境战意，克制项羽近身狂攻的战法。
巨蟹?樱木清澜，星阵核心续航兼耗杀担当，掌控幽冥水系星力，既能永续治愈己方星将，又能释放蚀骨毒雾、持续耗损敌方精血神魂，是拖垮绝境战力的无解核心。
天秤?樱木玄衡，星阵法则核心，执掌天地战力制衡，可精准稀释敌方爆发威力、叠加战力反噬，越是绝境暴涨的战力，反噬越重，完美克制项羽「愈战愈强」的逆天天赋。
其余法系、刺客、远程星曜全程联动控场、补刀压制，层层锁死战局。
“挡我护国之路者，尽皆可杀！”
项羽怒啸长空，声浪震碎周遭星雾，霸王枪骤然横扫，磅礴枪气如龙出海、横贯四方，一瞬震退狮子?阿煌的强攻之势。
反手一枪洞穿巨蟹?樱木清澜的星雾防御，枪尖贯体、巨力爆发，将巨蟹?樱木清澜狠狠砸翻在地。
枪力震得对方星甲开裂、气血翻涌、大口呕血，身受重创，直接打残敌方核心续航点。
一枪重创一尊老牌星曜，项羽脚步未停、攻势不止，身形极速突进，霸王枪连环突刺，枪影如龙穿梭、灵动迅猛。
接连洞穿四名近身围堵的星曜死士胸膛，枪出夺命、招招必杀、无一落空。
狮子?阿煌仰天长啸，狂暴狮吼音波化作无形冲击波，直袭项羽识海，妄图乱其心神、破其战意。
可项羽道心坚如磐石、百战不移，仅眉头微蹙，脚步未曾后退半步，大步踏前，枪指大阵核心，语气凛冽。
“小小星道诡阵，也想困杀我项羽！可笑！”
绝境之中，杀机迭起、层层加码，多重星曜无解压制同步降临。
双子?樱木幻影幻境强势笼罩其身，万千虚妄惨状入眼，死死扰乱心神判断、动摇战场认知。
水瓶?樱木辰光寒冰锁死双脚，冻土缠足、寒冰覆体，彻底封禁其最擅长的迅猛冲锋、近身突进优势。
天蝎?阿刺星针疾射膝盖关节，专攻下盘薄弱之处、破其根基，限制身法移动。
射手?阿矢利箭直指双目、咽喉等防守死角，刁钻致命、防不胜防。
项羽枪影轮转如风、密不透风，尽数格挡粉碎袭来的箭雨星针。
同时枪势横扫八方，百丈之内但凡有星兵靠近，尽数被磅礴枪气震碎身躯、血肉横飞。
短短数息，上百星兵殒命枪下，尸骸遍地、血染焦土。
可单人勇武，终究难敌闭环体系的全方位碾压。
每一次全力出枪、每一次绝境爆发，处女?樱木灵丹的净化之力便消解一分武道修为，天秤?樱木玄衡的法则反噬便加重一层。
他的体力飞速流逝、本源持续耗空，新旧伤势层层叠加、遍布周身，皮肉开裂、筋骨受损。
content_en:
The battlefield of the front army in Duanlongyuan was filled with evil spirits, eternally tragic, and the mournful wind roared across the border carrying the bloody sand.
The nine-foot towering body stands erect on the blood and earth, its heavy eyes are piercing, and its energy penetrates the mountains and rivers.
Xiang Yu, the Overlord of Western Chu, held the Overlord's Spear, the cold light of the spear's tip pierced through the remaining clouds, and the iron-blooded evil energy on his body caused the surrounding star patterns to tremble violently, and the light and dark were unstable.
Among the four war gods, he is the best at fighting against the odds, becoming more courageous the longer he fights. With the immense strength and unyielding pride of thousands of enemies, his combat power can skyrocket in desperate situations. He is not afraid of death and fights more fiercely. His only shortcomings are unaided, no battery life, and fear of continuous consumption and multi-dimensional superposition suppression.
The Twelve Stars were extremely afraid of its ultimate desperate combat power and did not dare to underestimate it. They accurately mobilized three core main forces to encircle them, focusing on their shortcomings in consumption and eliminating any possibility of a comeback.
Lion? Ahuang, the overlord of close combat attacks in the Star Formation. The lion is domineering and physically strong. He is good at frontal crushing and sound waves. He specializes in fighting against desperate situations and restrains Xiang Yu's close combat tactics.
Cancer? Sakuragi Qinglan, the core of the star array is responsible for sustaining and killing. He controls the star power of the nether water system. He can not only continuously heal his own star generals, but also release bone-corrosive poisonous mist and continuously consume the enemy's essence, blood and soul. He is the insoluble core that brings down the combat power in desperate situations.
Libra? Sakuragi Genhira, the core of the Star Array Law, controls the balance of the combat power of heaven and earth. He can accurately dilute the enemy's explosive power and superimpose the combat power backlash. The more desperate the situation, the more the combat power surges, the heavier the backlash. It perfectly restrains Xiang Yu's heaven-defying talent of "getting stronger the more he fights".
The other magic systems, assassins, and long-range stars are fully linked to control the field and suppress last hits, locking the battle at every level.
"Anyone who stands in the way of protecting our country will be killed!"
Xiang Yu roared angrily into the sky, the sound wave shattered the surrounding star mist, and the Overlord Spear suddenly swept across. The majestic spear energy was like a dragon coming out of the sea, traversing all directions, instantly repelling the strong attack of Lion A Huang.
A backhand shot penetrated the star mist defense of the giant crab Sakuragi Qinglan. The tip of the spear penetrated the body and exploded with great force, slamming the giant crab Sakuragi Qinglan to the ground.
The force of the gun caused the opponent's star armor to crack, causing blood to surge, causing him to vomit blood. He was severely injured and directly disabled the enemy's core life point.
A shot severely damaged an old star. Xiang Yu did not stop and continued his offensive. He rushed forward at a very fast speed, and stabbed continuously with the Overlord Spear. The shadow of the spear shuttled like a dragon, agile and fierce.
One after another, he penetrated the chests of the four Xingyao dead soldiers who were closely surrounded, and shot out his guns to kill, and every move was sure to kill, and none of them missed.
The lion? Ah Huang looked up to the sky and roared. The sound wave of the violent lion roar turned into an invisible shock wave, directly attacking Xiang Yu's sea of ​​consciousness, trying to confuse his mind and break his fighting spirit.
But Xiang Yu's Taoist heart was as solid as a rock and he would never waver in every battle. He only frowned slightly and never took a step back. He strode forward with his gun pointed at the core of the formation and his tone was stern.
"The little starry formation also wants to trap and kill me, Xiang Yu! It's ridiculous!"
In a desperate situation, murderous intentions are rising one after another, layers of pressure are being increased, and multiple stars are suppressing them simultaneously.
Twins? The phantom of Sakuragi enveloped his body powerfully, and thousands of false and tragic scenes entered his eyes, disrupting his mental judgment and shaking his understanding of the battlefield.
Aquarius? Sakuragi Chenguang's feet are locked with ice, frozen soil binds his feet, and his body is covered with ice, completely blocking his best advantage of swift charge and close attack.
The Scorpio? Athorn star needle shoots quickly at the knee joint, focusing on the weak points of the lower body, breaking its foundation, and restricting the movement of the body.
Archer? Aya's sharp arrows are aimed directly at the eyes, throat and other defensive blind spots. They are tricky, deadly and difficult to guard against.
The shadows of Xiang Yu's spear rotated like the wind and were airtight, blocking and smashing all the incoming arrows and stars.
At the same time, the gun force swept across all directions, and any Star Soldier within a hundred feet who approached would have their bodies shattered by the majestic gun energy, and their flesh and blood flew everywhere.
In just a few breaths, hundreds of star soldiers were killed by gunshots, with corpses strewn all over the ground and blood staining the scorched earth.
But if you are brave enough alone, you will eventually be unable to defeat the all-round crushing of the closed-loop system.
Every time a gun is drawn with full force, every desperate situation breaks out, the purifying power of Maiden Sakuragi's elixir will dissolve a point of martial arts cultivation, and the backlash of Libra Sakuragi Xuanheng's law will be aggravated.
His physical strength was rapidly passing away, and his energy was continuously depleted. New and old injuries were piled on top of each other and spread all over his body. His skin and flesh were cracked, and his muscles and bones were damaged.
title_en: Chapter 9: The overlord breaks the river and the iron-blooded proud man is buried in the sand. Chapter 10: The two hammers sleep forever and the four gods die and the country collapses.
